responsibility: Implements x86 PE/COFF and Windows-specific backend support for symbol attributes, calling-convention decoration, export/import handling, and SEH/unwind assembly emission. This file validates and applies attributes such as shared and selectany, decides dllimport/dllexport behavior for declarations, constructs stdcall/fastcall name suffixing, records exported symbols and function types for PE output, and emits .seh directives and unwind metadata from frame-related RTL during function assembly, making it the main Windows object-format companion to the generic x86 backend.
